queries:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT c.gender AS gender, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS cnt
  FROM Orders o
  JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  JOIN Invoices i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
  GROUP BY c.gender
),
s AS (
  SELECT gender, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM g) AS share
  FROM g
)
SELECT gender, cnt AS count, share, share - 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM g) AS share_minus_avg
FROM s
WHERE share > 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM g);
SELECT c.gender, COUNT(i.invoice_number) AS invoiced_orders
FROM Customers c
JOIN Orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN Invoices i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY c.gender;
WITH g AS (
  SELECT c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM Orders o
  JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.gender
),
t AS (
  SELECT SUM(order_count) AS total, COUNT(*) AS n FROM g
)
SELECT g.gender,
       g.order_count,
       (g.order_count * 1.0 / t.total) / (1.0 / t.n) AS share_to_average_ratio
FROM g, t;
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(gender, ''), 'Unknown') AS gender, COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM Customers
GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(gender, ''), 'Unknown');
